homepage.title:
CRM VORTEX —
a reliable, proven management system
for auto parts stores and workshops
homepage.subtitle: CRM Vortex gives you full control over your auto parts business and workshop: from inventory and orders to finances and employee performance. One system brings 95% of operations into a single interface, reducing losses, streamlining teamwork and increasing profit.

about_us_block.about_us_subtitle: Vortex offers tools you will not find in other CRMs: flexible inventory management, separate interfaces for managers and packers, an advanced status matrix and automated fiscal receipts. Improve process accuracy, reduce lost orders and focus on growing your business.

about_us_blocks.about_us_title: Auto parts store and workshop management in one place
about_us_blocks.about_us_description: Designed specifically for your industry, with a focus on inventory, orders, customers and service records, without unnecessary features.
Replace Excel with a modern system that simplifies record keeping, speeds up order processing and helps prevent errors.
Connect to major auto parts suppliers and catalogs. Prices and stock levels update automatically, with no manual work.
We will build a modern website for your store. Choose a free template website or a custom solution tailored to your needs.

about_us_blocks.about_us_title: Share information with other Vortex customers
about_us_blocks.about_us_description: Connect with other stores using Vortex and exchange information about parts availability.
Control every step from inquiry to sale. Fewer losses, better service, more orders.

suppliers_section.description: Vortex brings all suppliers’ stock together in one place and simplifies working with them. These integrations let you automatically receive price lists, place orders and download invoices via API.

sync_section.title: Vortex Sync
paragraphs: Our Sync technology lets you quickly set up online stock and order exchange with another store using Vortex.
You decide whether other customers can find you, which stock to share and which markup to apply.
Stock received via Sync has a special tag. Ordering it automatically creates an order on the other side and notifies the managers. You receive the same notification when a partner orders from you.
No manual stock updates are needed: Sync handles them for you.

FAQ.topic: How long does the demo last?
FAQ.answer: The demo is free for 14 days and includes the same features as the paid version.

FAQ.topic: Will the data I enter be kept after the trial?
FAQ.answer: We recommend testing all features without worrying about mistakes. After the trial, we can delete or retain any of your data, as you choose.

FAQ.topic: How is my data protected from loss and disclosure to third parties?
FAQ.answer: Our servers are hosted in reliable data centers in Germany and Finland. You can download stock, business partner and balance files yourself or schedule automatic email delivery. A mutual non-disclosure agreement is also available.

FAQ.topic: I need additional features. What can you offer?
FAQ.answer: If the program does not meet a particular need, we can develop additional features after agreeing on the cost and timeline.

1. Upload your stock using the price list importer and select “-1” in the warehouse field. The file must contain four columns: part number, brand, quantity and purchase price.

car_service.title: Workshop management
car_service.subtitle: Vortex helps not only auto parts stores but also vehicle service centers manage their business.

blocks.title: Workshop job catalog
paragraphs: The program includes a basic workshop job catalog with around 15 categories and 10–20 jobs in each. You can add your own categories and jobs.
Each job supports a category, name, standard labor hours, hourly rate, currency and note.

You can attach parts inquiry templates to jobs. For example, link a “cabin filter” template to “replace cabin filter”. When booking this job, the system offers to send a parts inquiry to the sales manager automatically.

blocks.title: Documents
paragraphs: Printed documents play an important role in any business, including workshops. Vortex recognizes this and continually improves its document system.
Today, virtually every action in Vortex comes with a corresponding document and a printable form.
blocks.list_intro: Examples of workshop documents our customers often ask about:
blocks.note: *For an additional fee, Vortex can customize a document’s print layout to your needs.

blocks.title: Workshop bookings
paragraphs: A booking requires the customer, service bay and appointment time. Add jobs immediately or later if the work is not yet known. Record the customer’s vehicle, including VIN, registration number, mileage, make, model and specifications. A change history is kept for each booking and job, so you always know who changed what and when.
items: Attach files to bookings (.pdf, .xlsx, .png and more).
Apply discounts to jobs.
Complete a booking in stages and issue multiple work completion certificates for one booking.
Mechanics can mark individual jobs as done without closing the booking, making progress clear.
Mileage is saved in the customer’s garage. Read more in the sections below.

blocks.title: Statistics
paragraphs: Vortex workshop statistics bring all key business metrics together in one comprehensive module.
items: Earnings by service bay
Earnings by mechanic
Earnings by service advisor
Total workshop earnings
Workshop expenses by category
Most popular jobs
Jobs completed by each mechanic over a period

blocks.title: Booking calendar
paragraphs: The booking calendar gives you a clear view of workshop activity, helps you find available slots quickly and makes booking management easy.
items: All service bays for a selected day.
A selected service bay for the week.
closing_paragraphs: Create a booking by clicking its start and end times. You can also quickly edit, cancel or complete bookings.
Each Vortex customer has a cart that can include workshop jobs. Add the required jobs first, then create a calendar booking directly from that cart.

blocks.title: Mileage history
paragraphs: Vehicle details entered in a workshop booking are saved in the customer’s garage. Entering mileage creates a mileage history entry, recording which jobs were carried out at which mileage and helping plan scheduled maintenance.

The mileage module supports reminders by date, mileage or both. Date reminders send the customer an SMS on the chosen day. Mileage reminders notify the manager when a new booking records a mileage above the set threshold.

vchasno.lead: A software cash register for fiscalising sales in Vortex: electronic receipts, cash registers and cashier keys within your order and payment workflow.

sections.title: How fiscalisation works
paragraphs: The manager processes a sale or payment in Vortex. The system sends the goods or services, amount, payment type, cash register and cashier to Vchasno.Kasa. The service issues a fiscal receipt and submits the data to the tax authority while the manager continues working with the order.

sections.title: What you need to connect

Configure tax groups and payment types.
Add the cashier key and connection settings in Vortex.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy_policy.lead: How we process personal data of website visitors and people contacting us about Vortex products and services.

sections.title: About this policy and contacting us
sections.html:
This policy applies to the public Vortex website, its enquiry forms, language selection and contact with the team through the details listed on the website. It explains what information we receive through these activities, why we need it and how you can exercise your rights in relation to it.

The controller of personal data received through this website is ФОП Маркович В.Ю., identification number 3258910312. In this document, “Vortex”, “we” and “our” mean this sole proprietor and the team that operates the website and handles enquiries on the proprietor’s behalf.

For questions about personal data and exercising your rights, contact crm.vtx@gmail.com. Correspondence address: Україна, м. Ужгород, вул. Капушанська, 154а.

We process data with regard to the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection”. Where the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applies to specific processing, its requirements also apply.

This policy describes the marketing website. The terms governing data processing within the CRM itself, your customer database or the performance of a separate contract are set out in the relevant contracts and notices. Visiting the website or reading this policy does not itself constitute consent to any use of personal data.

sections.title: Information we receive
sections.html:
You do not need to create an account to view the pages. If you submit a request for a trial, demonstration, website development or a TecDoc licence, the form sends:

  • your name or another form of address you provide and your telephone number;
  • the product concerned, the submission page and your selected language;
  • the calculated amount, where the form provides one, and the website package, if selected;
  • coordinates and location accuracy, if you separately add your geolocation;
  • a technical reCAPTCHA token used to verify that the request is genuine.

When you contact us by email, telephone or messenger, we also receive information you choose to share and the details needed to reply. Please do not send passwords, payment card details, copies of documents or sensitive information unless they are needed for the agreed service.

To deliver web pages and protect the website, the server and its infrastructure process technical connection details, including the IP address, request time and HTTP header data. The content and retention periods of technical logs depend on the hosting configuration. The IP address is also sent to Google during server-side reCAPTCHA verification.

The website form does not request bank card details or process payments. Displaying a price or a calculated amount is not, in itself, a payment transaction.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases for processing
sections.html:
We need your name, telephone number and enquiry context to respond, clarify your needs, arrange a demonstration or prepare an offer. Where an enquiry concerns a future contract, the basis is taking steps at your request before entering into that contract; for an ordered service, it is performance of the contract.

Technical data and anti-spam verification are used to protect forms, prevent abuse and keep the website working. The basis may be our legitimate interest in operating the service securely, taking account of your rights and applicable legal requirements. Where a technology requires prior consent by law, legitimate interest does not replace that consent.

Optional geolocation is based on your separate voluntary choice. Where data is needed to meet a statutory obligation, processing is based on that obligation. We do not treat submission of an enquiry as unrestricted permission to send advertising messages.

Not providing mandatory contact details does not prevent you from browsing the website, but it makes form submission or a reply to the missing contact impossible. Automated form verification and indicative price calculation are not automated decisions producing legal effects for you.

sections.title: Voluntary sharing of geolocation
sections.html:
Your location is requested only after you press the button to add a location and grant permission in the browser. It is attached to the enquiry so the team can take your location into account when responding. This feature does not continuously track your movements.

You can leave the button untouched or decline the browser request: the form remains available without coordinates. If you do not want to send a location you have already added, reload the page before submitting the form. You can revoke permission for future access in your browser settings.

Revoking browser permission does not delete coordinates you have already submitted. To request deletion of data from a previous enquiry, email crm.vtx@gmail.com.

sections.title: Cookies and browser local storage
sections.html:
To remember your chosen language, the website stores a vortex-language value in a cookie and in the browser’s local storage (localStorage). The value contains a language code, not your name or telephone number.

  • Language cookie: set when you choose a language, for up to 365 days; choosing again renews this period.
  • localStorage: stores your language choice without an automatic expiry set by the website, until you clear the data or the browser removes it.
  • reCAPTCHA: may set the service cookie _GRECAPTCHA and use other Google technologies to protect against automated requests.

You can delete this data or restrict its storage in your browser settings. Clearing it may reset your language preference; blocking Google services may prevent verification and form submission. In that case, you can contact the team directly.

The current website version does not include separate advertising pixels or third-party web analytics systems. This does not exclude technical processing by the third-party services described in this policy.

sections.title: Protecting forms with reCAPTCHA
sections.html:
When Google reCAPTCHA is configured, pages containing a form load its script. During loading and verification, Google receives technical interaction data, including the IP address and browser information; the service may use cookies. The website server sends Google the verification token and the request’s IP address.

The website does not include the name and telephone fields in the server-side reCAPTCHA verification request. After successful verification, the token is not included in the team’s Telegram message.

More about the service: reCAPTCHA documentation, Google Privacy Policy and Google Terms of Service. If you do not wish to use a form with this service, contact us directly.

sections.title: Who may receive data
sections.html:
Enquiries are received by Vortex employees and engaged specialists who need the information to respond, advise or provide a service. Technical operation of the website involves a hosting provider and, where necessary, other contractors supporting its operation.

To display the typeface, pages load Google Fonts styles and files from fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com. This connection occurs when browsing the website, independently of form submission. Google receives technical request details, including the IP address, browser information and request source within the configured referrer settings. The website does not include the form’s name and telephone fields in font loading requests. See the Google Fonts privacy FAQ for details.

Form enquiries are delivered to the team through the Telegram Bot API. A message includes the name, telephone number and, depending on the form, language, page, amount, package and coordinates. A TecDoc enquiry message includes the name and telephone number. This transfer takes place on the server: you do not need a Telegram account.

Telegram processes messages in its cloud infrastructure under its own privacy policy. A bot message is not an end-to-end encrypted secret chat. Please do not submit information that is unnecessary for contacting you.

Google also receives certain technical data for reCAPTCHA as described above. Data may be disclosed to competent authorities where expressly required by law and supported by an appropriate legal basis. We do not sell contact details from enquiries or publish them on the website.

sections.title: Processing outside Ukraine
sections.html:
Using Google, Telegram and their providers’ infrastructure may involve processing outside Ukraine and, for users in the European Economic Area, outside the EEA. The website itself does not determine the location of all servers used by these services; their providers’ policies describe their processing.

International transfers are subject to personal data protection law, including Article 29 of the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection” and, where applicable, the GDPR rules on transfers to third countries. Using the website does not itself constitute separate consent to any international transfer.

You can request information about recipients and the legal basis for transferring the data of a specific enquiry through our privacy contact.

sections.title: Retention periods and deletion
sections.html:
Contact details and correspondence are kept for as long as needed to handle the enquiry and communicate about the requested service. If the relationship continues, retention periods may be determined by the contract, mandatory legal requirements or a justified need to defend rights in a dispute. Data should not be retained longer than necessary for its purpose.

The current form delivers the enquiry to Telegram; it does not create a separate visitor account with an enquiry history. Copies of messages may remain in work correspondence and providers’ infrastructure. Closing a page or clearing the browser does not delete an enquiry already sent; the form does not automatically delete messages after a fixed number of days.

Technical logs are retained according to infrastructure settings and security needs. Google and Telegram retention periods are also governed by those services’ rules. Local retention of your language preference is described in the cookies section.

To clarify the retention period for your enquiry or request deletion, write to us. If some data must be retained on a lawful basis, our reply will explain that basis and the relevant period or the criteria used to determine it.

sections.title: Information security
sections.html:
Enquiries are protected through input field validation, request size limits and anti-spam verification. Enquiry data is transferred to Google and Telegram over HTTPS. Integration keys are used on the server and are not included in the enquiry message content.

No transmission or storage method provides absolute security. Do not add excessive data, check the website address before submitting and inform us if you notice suspicious activity or possible disclosure of your information.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.html:
Within the scope and conditions established by applicable law, you have the right to:

  • learn the sources, purposes and conditions of processing your data and information about its controller and recipients;
  • access your own personal data;
  • request correction of inaccurate data and deletion of data processed unlawfully or no longer needed;
  • object to processing where the grounds provided by law exist;
  • withdraw consent where it was the basis for processing, without affecting the lawfulness of previous processing;
  • defend your rights in court and lodge a complaint with the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights.

Where the GDPR applies, restriction of processing, data portability and a complaint to a competent supervisory authority are also available under its conditions, including in the place of your habitual residence, work or an alleged infringement. These rights are not absolute: for example, deletion may be limited by a legal retention obligation.

Information about rights and how to submit a request is available on the Commissioner’s website. The official GDPR text is available on EUR-Lex.

sections.title: How to exercise your rights
sections.html:
Email crm.vtx@gmail.com with the subject “Personal data”. Describe the data or enquiry concerned and the action you request. To start locating the enquiry, an approximate date and the contact details you provided are sufficient.

To avoid disclosing your data to someone else, we may request proportionate proof of identity and information required by law. Do not send a passport copy or other excessive documents without a separate, justified request.

Requests are handled within the legal deadlines for the relevant type of request. If there is a lawful basis to refuse, limit fulfilment or extend the deadline, we will inform you. Contacting us does not limit your right to approach a supervisory authority or court directly.

sections.title: External links and other people’s data
sections.html:
The website links to YouTube, messengers, social networks and other resources. After you follow a link, their operators process data under their own rules. In particular, video links lead to an external platform whose policy applies to viewing on that platform.

Send your own contact details or data you are legally entitled to share for the relevant enquiry. The website and its offers are primarily intended for professional use; the forms are not designed to collect children’s data. If you believe a child’s or another person’s data was shared without an appropriate basis, inform us so we can investigate and take necessary action.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.html:
We update this document when website features, processing arrangements or legal requirements change. The current version is published on this page with an update date. If a new processing purpose requires a separate notice or consent, publishing a new version does not replace obtaining them.

For any questions about this policy, email crm.vtx@gmail.com.
